snippet.title: Puzzling Places - Monthly Pack #2 DLC Trailer
snippet.description:
Introducing the Monthly Pack #2 - bringing you six new puzzles from all around the world for 4.99$! 

Available to purchase NOW in-app or through the Quest / PS VR stores! https://www.oculus.com/experiences/quest/3931148300302917/

This DLC Puzzle Pack includes:
- Chateau de Veves (Houyet, Belgium)
- Clock Tower in Yenisehir (Yenişehir, Turkey)
- Fire Station No. 6 (Baltimore, MD, USA)
- Ottoman Tombstone (Bursa, Turkey)
- Shikhar Temple (Lalitpur, Nepal)
- CFMoto X10 Quad Bike (N/A)

Special thanks to LZ Creation, AhmetGuner3d, Taylor Houlihan, Dystopia, and Viesturs Dille for providing photogrammetry scans. Detailed information about each puzzle: https://puzzlingplaces.ghost.io/m2/
